verdict.rationale: Flagright offers AI agents for AML operations, and its own case and alert model supports human review: alerts and cases can carry an `ESCALATED` status, and a Workflow Builder lets you build investigation flows around compliance logic. Nothing in the evidence shows a policy setting that limits what the AI agents can resolve on their own, or that routes ambiguous or high-risk findings to a human. Missing for 10: documented policy controls on AI auto-remediation, documented rules that trigger escalation to a human based on risk or ambiguity, detail on how the AI agents work with escalation, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
